name: Thridify – 3D Product Viewer, AR & Configurator for WooCommerce
author: Team Thridify

sections.description:
Thridify adds an interactive 3D product viewer, a product configurator and augmented reality (AR) to your WooCommerce store. Shoppers rotate the product a full 360 degrees, zoom into the details, switch materials, colours, finishes and sizes, then tap “View in your room” to place it at real size through their phone camera. When they like what they see, they add the configured product straight to the cart.

You build and publish 3D experiences in your Thridify account. This plugin connects your store, tells Thridify which products you sell, and shows the viewer on every product that has one. Products without an experience look exactly as they did before, so you can roll out 3D one product or one category at a time.

Live demo: try it on a real WooCommerce store at woo.thridify.com. More about the integration at thridify.com/integrations/woocommerce.

Why stores add 3D and AR

Photos show one angle. A 3D viewer lets shoppers look at the product from every side, check how a finish looks, and see whether it fits their space before they buy. That answers the questions that usually end in an abandoned cart, a support email or a return.

  • Raise conversion. Shoppers who can turn, configure and place a product understand it better and buy with more confidence.
  • Reduce returns. Seeing the real size, shape and finish in their own room cuts the “it looked different online” returns.
  • Sell configurable products online. Show every combination of material, colour and option without photographing each one.
  • Support B2B sales. Give trade buyers, dealers and project customers an accurate, interactive look at products they can’t see in person.

Built for every kind of product

Thridify works for any product where shape, size, material or fit matters:

  • Furniture and home: sofas and sectionals, chairs, tables, beds, office furniture and desks, outdoor and garden furniture, mattresses.
  • Kitchens and interiors: kitchens and cabinetry, wardrobes and closets, doors and windows, bathroom fittings and vanities, tiles and flooring.
  • Lighting and decor: lamps, pendants and light fixtures, home decor, rugs and carpets, wall art.
  • Fashion and accessories: jewelry, rings and watches, eyewear and sunglasses, footwear and sneakers, bags and fashion accessories.
  • Electronics and appliances: consumer electronics, gadgets, home and kitchen appliances.
  • Industrial and automotive: industrial machinery and B2B equipment, tools, automotive parts and accessories.

What you get

  • 3D product viewer on product pages. Show it as a 3D icon on the product gallery, a “View in 3D” button, or Images / 3D tabs under the gallery. Pick one, set the position, the button text and the button shape (square, rounded or pill).
  • 360 spin and zoom. Shoppers rotate the model in any direction and zoom in on the details, on desktop and mobile.
  • Product configurator. Materials, colours, finishes, sizes and options you set up in Thridify can be switched live in 3D.
  • AR “view in your room” on iPhone and Android. AR runs in the phone’s browser, served by Thridify. No app to install.
  • Variation sync. Picking a WooCommerce variation updates the 3D model, and choosing a finish in 3D selects the matching variation.
  • Add to cart from the viewer. The shopper’s configuration goes into the cart as a “Configuration” line on the item and stays on the order. WooCommerce sets the price, as always.
  • 3D badges on the shop grid. A 3D icon on product cards in the shop, category, tag and search pages tells shoppers which products they can explore in 3D.
  • “View in 3D button” block and [thridify_3d_button] shortcode, so you can place the button anywhere in your product template or page builder.
  • Catalog sync. Product IDs, SKUs, slugs and names of published products are sent to Thridify, so it can match each product to its experience by SKU, slug, name or ID.
  • 3D status in wp-admin. A “3D” column on the Products list shows which products have a published experience, and a per-product switch hides the viewer where you don’t want it.
  • Experience switcher and brand colour, saved straight to your Thridify account.
  • Optional 3D-assisted sales measurement (off by default): see how many orders followed a 3D or AR engagement, right in WooCommerce. Full funnel analytics (views, engagement, AR sessions) are in your Thridify dashboard.
  • Works with your setup: classic and block themes, the block cart and checkout, and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS). An “Isolated frame” rendering option avoids clashes with theme scripts and styles.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin, then open WooCommerce → Thridify 3D & AR.
  2. Click “Connect with Thridify”, sign in to Thridify (or create an account), and confirm. You come straight back to WordPress.
  3. Your catalog syncs in the background. Products that match a published experience show the 3D viewer, configurator and AR.

A Thridify account is required. You can create one during the connect step.

External services

This plugin connects to Thridify, a hosted service operated by 14818032 Canada Inc. (operating as Thridify). Nothing is sent to Thridify until a store administrator clicks “Connect with Thridify”.

  • Account connection (api.thridify.com): when you connect, your browser is sent to Thridify to sign in and approve. The plugin then receives a connection token and sends your site’s address so Thridify can allow it to load your experiences.
  • Catalog sync (api.thridify.com): after connecting, a few minutes after products change, and daily, the plugin sends the product ID, SKU, slug and name of each published product. Prices, stock and customer data are never sent.
  • Viewer (viewer.thridify.com, models.thridify.com, admin.thridify.com): on product and shop pages, shoppers’ browsers load Thridify’s viewer script and the product’s 3D files. Like any web request, this shares the shopper’s IP address and browser details with Thridify. The Products list in wp-admin also checks models.thridify.com to show which products have 3D.
  • Settings (api.thridify.com): the Experience switcher tab and the “Send brand colour to Thridify” button read and save settings in your Thridify account when you use them.
  • 3D-assisted sales (api.thridify.com, only if you turn it on): when an order is paid or refunded, the plugin sends the order ID, total, currency, item count and whether it followed a 3D engagement. No names, addresses, emails or payment details. On the storefront it sets a first-party cookie, _thridify_3d (30 days), after a shopper engages 3D. If your cookie banner supports the WP Consent API, the cookie is only set with statistics consent.

If you choose the Sandbox environment (enterprise accounts only), the same calls go to devviewer.thridify.com, devmodels.thridify.com, devadmin.thridify.com and api-dev.thridify.com instead.

Thridify Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install from Plugins → Add New (search for “Thridify”), or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Thridify 3D & AR and click “Connect with Thridify”.
  4. In Display, choose how the viewer appears. In Catalog, choose how products are matched (SKU by default).
sections.faq:
How do I add a 3D model to a WooCommerce product?

Upload or create the model in your Thridify account and publish it as an experience. Then connect this plugin and make sure the product’s SKU (or slug, name or ID, whichever you match on) is the same in WooCommerce and Thridify. The viewer appears on that product page automatically. You don’t upload 3D files to the WordPress media library.

Does it support GLB and USDZ?

Yes. Your models live in your Thridify account, and the viewer serves GLB in the browser and on Android, and USDZ for AR on iPhone and iPad. You don’t need to manage the formats yourself.

Does AR work on iPhone and Android without an app?

Yes. Shoppers tap the AR button and the product opens in their phone camera, straight from the browser, at real size in their room. Nothing to download.

Can shoppers configure a product and add it to the cart?

Yes. Shoppers pick materials, colours, finishes and options in 3D, then add the product to the cart from the viewer. The configuration is saved on the cart item and the order as a “Configuration” line, so you know exactly what to make or ship. WooCommerce keeps setting the price.

Does the 3D model follow WooCommerce variations?

Yes. Choosing a variation on the product page updates the 3D model, and choosing a finish inside the viewer selects the matching variation.

Can I show a 360 product view instead of photos?

The 3D viewer gives shoppers a full 360 degree view they control themselves, with zoom. You can show it alongside your photos as Images / 3D tabs, behind a button, or as an icon on the gallery.

Which industries is it for?

Any product where look, size or fit matters: furniture, sofas, office furniture, kitchens and cabinetry, wardrobes, doors and windows, bathroom fittings, tiles and flooring, lighting, home decor and rugs, mattresses, outdoor furniture, jewelry, eyewear, footwear and fashion accessories, electronics, appliances, industrial and B2B equipment, and automotive parts.

Will 3D and AR reduce returns?

They remove a common reason for returns: the product turning out bigger, smaller or a different finish than the shopper expected. Seeing it in 3D and at real size in their room sets the right expectation before they order.

Do I need to know 3D or write code?

No. You connect your account with one click and choose display options in WooCommerce settings. Placement works with the default layout, the block or the shortcode.

Is there a live demo?

Yes. Try the viewer, configurator and AR on a real WooCommerce store at woo.thridify.com.

Do I need a Thridify account?

Yes. The 3D models, experiences and AR are hosted by Thridify. You can create an account during the connect step.

A product doesn’t show the viewer. Why?

The viewer only appears when Thridify has a published experience that matches the product. Check that the experience is published in Thridify and that the value you match on (SKU by default) is the same in both places. The Catalog tab lists examples of products that did not match, and the Products list shows a “3D” column.

Can I put the button somewhere specific?

Yes. Add the “View in 3D button” block to your single-product template, or use [thridify_3d_button] in a classic template or page builder. Set Product pages to “Off” if you only want the button where you placed it.

Does it slow down my pages?

The plugin adds one small script and checks a ~1 KB file per product. The 3D viewer itself only loads when a product has an experience, and the heavy files load when the shopper opens it.

Does it work with my theme?

It targets WooCommerce’s own templates and product blocks, so most themes work without changes. If a theme’s scripts or styles conflict with the viewer, switch Rendering to “Isolated frame”.

What data is sent to Thridify?

Only what the External services section lists: product IDs, SKUs, slugs and names for catalog sync, and, if you turn on 3D-assisted sales, order totals without any customer details. Prices, stock and customer data are never sent.

What happens when I disconnect or uninstall?

Disconnecting releases your site from your Thridify account and the viewer stops showing. Uninstalling also deletes the plugin’s settings. Orders keep their “Configuration” lines because they are part of the order.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Images / 3D tabs now sit under the gallery on themes that lay the product page out as a row (such as Blocksy), instead of squeezing in beside it.
  • The 3D icon on shop and category cards now sits over the product photo on themes that keep the image and title in separate links (such as Blocksy).

1.0.4

  • Readme and listing refresh.

1.0.3

  • Viewer tooltips no longer break one letter per line on block themes that use Columns.

1.0.2

  • Images / 3D tabs sit below the gallery on block themes.
  • The 3D icon on product cards and galleries now has a light backdrop, so it stays visible on dark product photos.

1.0.1

  • Images / 3D tabs: the viewer always fits the product gallery, including slider galleries.
  • New “Button shape” setting (square, rounded or pill).

1.0.0

  • First release: connect with Thridify, catalog sync, product-page icon, button and tabs, shop-card icons, View in 3D block and shortcode, variation sync, add to cart from 3D, experience switcher, brand colour, optional 3D-assisted sales measurement.
